summary: Short film of employees leaving a photographic factory in Lyon, made by the brothers Auguste and Louis Lumiere. It was among the first films shown to a paying audience in Paris in 1895, an event often counted as cinema's start.
aliases: La Sortie de l'usine Lumière à Lyon
